content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or equivalent with 05 yrs practical experience in Civil Engineering works, Knowledge of AutoCad, and Knowledge of Konkani. Experience: 05 yrs practical experience in Civil Engineering works Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on 17 November 2026) Age relaxation: Project Cell employees up to 05 years Other conditions: Knowledge of Konkani is required. Knowledge of Marathi is desirable. Must possess valid certificate regarding 15 years residence in the State of Goa issued by the Mamlatdar, with specific exemptions. Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GTDC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates with incomplete applications or applications received after the due date.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly pay of contractual employees is fixed and paid as per Government guidelines in para 4 of Office Memorandum No. 10/1/77-PER dated 24/06/2015 of the Department of Personnel, Government of Goa. Purely on contract basis for an initial period of 03 years. Period of contractual appointment shall be further extended from time to time depending upon the workload.

content_sections.heading: How Will GTDC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of eligible candidates Oral interview Only eligible candidates shall be called for oral interview by issue of call letters.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificate of Educational qualification with mark sheet Certificate of other qualification Experience Certificate Birth Certificate Valid certificate regarding 15 years residence in the State of Goa or documentary evidence for exempted categories

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GTDC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed Application Form. Fill in the application completely and correctly. Attach self-attested copies of required certificates and documents. Submit the application in person or at the office of Project Cell on or before 17/11/2026 by 5:00 pm. Obtain an acknowledgement slip upon submission.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The crucial date for determining eligibility shall be the last date fixed for submission of application.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GTDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GTDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Technical Assistant (Civil).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GTDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (official website of GTDC Ltd: www.goa-tourism.com and www.goa.gov.in) and send it to Project Cell, Special Purpose Vehicle (GTDC Ltd), 4th Floor, Paryatan Bhavan, Patto Panaji-Goa, by by hand, to reach by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on 17 November 2026). Relaxation: Project Cell employees up to 05 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in Civil Engineering with 5 years practical experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Konkani is required. Knowledge of Marathi is desirable. Must possess valid certificate regarding 15 years residence in the State of Goa issued by the Mamlatdar, with specific exemptions.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with incomplete applications or applications received after the due date.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of eligible candidates. Oral interview. Only eligible candidates shall be called for oral interview by issue of call letters.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contract basis for an initial period of 03 years. Period of contractual appointment shall be further extended from time to time depending upon the workload.
